function.name: SET_POSITION
function.param: Number of channel returned by PLAY_WAV
Angle with respect to the player, in degrees (0-360)
function.abstract: It changes the 3D positioning of a channel

description.p: This function allows to alter the sound of a certain channel simulating a positioning in 3D of the same one, from an angle of position and a distance to the player. The parameters (0,0) leave the sound as it were in the beginning, while a distance of 255 makes the sound inaudible.
This function leaks the sound of a channel of a somewhat slow form, without making use of the advanced characteristics of some audio cards. If you want a simple emulation, is faster to call to .
